contracts.docstring: A stable machine value and a readable label for a suggested answer.
An explicit selection; free-text answers remain a separate wire type.
Validate native question inputs while accepting persisted text-only choices.
Reuse the same domain parser for HTTP, MCP and stored question payloads.
Record a grouped information request without granting new runtime authority.
Keep every question's original ID and readable content in one durable group.
Apply byte bounds and identity checks after wire-shape validation.
Bind free text or explicit option selections to an observed question context.
Persist original choice identities and free text in the owner's observed context, without inference.
Describe only an actually recorded catalog header and complete text hash; historical unversioned policy stays unknown rather than being retroactively labelled.
Translate host-owned business tools to scoped HTTP without owning grants or inference.

Record required owner input whenever missing information materially changes the requested result or next action. A prose-only question does not create an answerable request: call this tool after useful independent work, unless current context already answers it. Ask 1–3 grouped questions with distinct ids, clear question text, why_needed, optional example and 0 or 2–4 options. Prefer {id,label} options with distinct stable IDs and readable labels; historical text-only choices remain supported. Free-text answers remain allowed; a conditional example never confirms an unknown premise. Never request secrets or use this as permission to publish. The host withdraws tool authority and closes this turn before waiting. Reuse operation_key after a lost receipt; do not continue or start another question. An answer records context for a future explicit run, not acceptance or authorization.
Keep a stable selection identity separate from its user-facing label.
Reject ambiguous or unbounded identities before they enter a durable question.
One correctable information request, retaining historical text-only choices.
Validate bounded question content and distinct identities without rewriting old choices.
A bounded group whose complete answers are correlated by exact question and option identities.
Require a small complete question group before pausing work for human input.
Preserve old string choices and encode new choices as explicit ID/label objects.
Treat free text literally and accept structured selections only from the original options.
Describe every question with readable labels while retaining IDs in the saved payload.
Explain selected labels and original IDs without converting typed strings into inferred choices.
Load current or historical question JSON without inventing identities for old text choices.
Read owner-visible execution receipts and captured evidence without issuing agent authority.
Page all pending requests with original question identities and their owning task's observed priority.
Create one bound native question; use a new operation key for a genuinely new request in a later context.
Selecting a real capability includes common correction/communication policy exactly once and a hash of the complete actual instructions.
A stored older header retains its original version and exact hash after the current catalog advances.
The real owner/store/broker/Ken path sends catalog policy and freezes its exact bytes; a simulated native answer is not evidence of human comprehension.
Use two distinct questions and labels that cannot be substituted for their option identifiers.
A selected ID and a typed identical string remain different evidence about what the user supplied.
One owner answer commits the original question identities and human thread without starting inference.
Old persisted string choices keep their shape; new labels cannot conceal repeated identity.
Expose every pending request with its own readiness, thread and observed task priority.
Prepare synthetic resources, own the live service/browser, and preserve every result on failure.

scope: New/changed Python definitions and modules in this delivery. New frontend modules and exported behavior have English JSDoc; this Python audit does not certify all historical definitions.
